SELECT
  MAX(subq_10.first_buyer_count) AS first_buyer_count
  , MAX(subq_10.first_order_sales_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
  , MAX(subq_10.first_order_count) AS first_order_count
  , MAX(subq_17.repeat_order_count) AS repeat_order_count
FROM (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_buyer_count
    , SUM(first_net_cents) AS first_order_sales_cents
    , SUM(CASE WHEN member_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."member_first_valid_order" member_first_valid_order_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', first_ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_10
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN case when first_seq > 1 then order_id end IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_order_count
  FROM "data"."main"."orders_valid_ranked" orders_valid_ranked_src_10000
  WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31'
) subq_17
answer: 2026年8月，青禾（本周合成测试库，按CRM会员账户统计）的观测期首购会员数为5个账户；观测期首单净销售额为128.00元；观测期首单数为5单；观测期后续购买订单数为22单。口径说明：先用全部数据覆盖期（2024-09-01至2026-09-01）确定每个账户的首笔有效订单，再按8月窗口归属——首购会员数和首单数统计的是账户首笔有效订单落在8月的数量，首单净销售额按各账户首单的净销售额合计（订单按日期、订单号排序确定首单）；后续购买订单数统计账户第二笔及以后的有效订单按下单日期落在8月的数量。本次统计未附加门店等额外筛选，首购为覆盖期内的观测首购，不代表终身首购。
